displayName: Agent Name : Branch Specific Write Access
author: rakesh.shukla
description: On-demand agent. The user signs in to GitHub (incl. authenticator app); the agent then opens each configured repo's Settings > Collaborators and teams, clicks Direct access, stamps date/time and saves a screenshot.
home: C:WORKSPACEMulti AgentCUS AuditBranch Specific Write Access

outputs.zip: <agent name> <YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>.zip (this run's screenshots, in the output folder)

safety: Human performs authentication; no credentials are stored or handled by the agent
Aborts on GitHub restriction/rate-limit page; never retries or evades it

changelog.notes: Initial release. 9 tests passing (unit + fake-GitHub integration).
Okta/SSO login hardening: do not touch pages on the IdP domain, keep popups/new tabs open, log redirects and browser/tab close or crash events, fail clearly if the browser closes before login.

Fix: org SAML/SSO redirect (GitHub -> Okta) was treated as session lost and closed the browser. Agent now waits for the human to finish SSO, then continues. SSO path detection anchored to /orgs/<org>/saml|sso. 12 tests.

Fix: GitHub redirects to SAML/Okta from page script after domcontentloaded; agent judged the page too early and aborted/closed the browser. Now settles the page (networkidle + 2s) before checking, then waits for the human through SSO/sign-in (up to 3 rounds). Test fake now reproduces delayed redirect.
Highlighted capture banner (light background chips for repo name and date/time, larger text, inserted at top of page); zip of the run screenshots as "<agent name> <YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>.zip".
